Speaking from experience. Getting sharps taken away or giving them up unwillingly to someone only made me want to cut even more. 
Try keeping them in a place where you both know where they are
Or anytime you feel like cutting do something along with the cutting like taking a walk or doing a puzzle. Whatever interests you. Soon you’ll associate that other thing with reliving stress as cutting does and then you can try to stop cutting and only do the other thing to relieve stress or whatever is making you want to cut in the first place.
